newsitem.title: USA: China buys U.S. soybeans, oil in Nov 14 wk - USDA.
newsitem.headline: China buys U.S. soybeans, oil in Nov 14 wk - USDA.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday net U.S. soybean sales to China in the week ended Nov 14 totaled 185,400 tonnes and that soyoil sales were 42,500 tonnes.
In its weekly export sales report, USDA said the soybean sale activity included 9,600 tonnes in new sales, 180,900 tonnes in destination changes and 5,100 tonnes in cancellations.
It said the soyoil sales activity included 27,500 tonnes new sales, 20,000 tonnes in destination changes and 5,000 tonnes in cancellations.
